MRK.rationale: MRK's Q1 2026 results reveal a dramatic deterioration in profitability: net income swung to -$4.24B (EPS -$1.72) from +$5.08B (EPS +$2.01) a year prior, despite modest 4.9% revenue growth. Operating income collapsed to -$3.53B, indicating a massive non-recurring charge or write-down that wiped out the entire operating profit. The stock is trading at 33.4x diluted P/E (vs. 11-15x range over the prior year), reflecting the earnings collapse rather than genuine growth. P/B has expanded to 6.5x (vs. 4.0-5.6x historical range) while ROE has halved to 19.5% from 36.1%. The balance sheet shows total liabilities rising to $82.75B with equity declining to $45.93B. While the company raised full-year guidance to $65.8-67B revenue and Keytruda grew 8% to $8B, the Q1 earnings shock is severe and unexplained in the available data. Gardasil declined 22% in China/Japan. The failed Trodelvy-Keytruda lung cancer trial (June 9) removes a potential combination catalyst. With the stock near its 52-week high of $125.14 at $120.76, elevated valuation multiples on depressed earnings, and no clear near-term re-rating catalyst, the risk-reward is unfavorable.
